grammar_contract.input: An ordinary parse-that child ParserState at a source-native UTF-16 offset corresponding to one retained CSS-preprocessed position or EOF.
grammar_contract.operation: Inspect no more than the next three CSS input positions through direct parse-that terminals/combinators. Return true exactly for digit, sign+digit, dot+digit, or sign+dot+digit; otherwise false.
grammar_contract.composition: Both binding lanes run: direct candidate.parser(state), and string(prefix).map(predecessor).next(candidate).skip(string(continuation)).
grammar_contract.state_identity: Raw child and outer parent each return the identical ParserState object received.
grammar_contract.source_identity: Preserve ParserState.src own-property presence and exact string value/identity.
grammar_contract.predecessor: Replace any predecessor with the boolean result without depending on predecessor content. Seven binding representatives cover package-default undefined, null, false, 0, empty string, frozen array, and frozen object. All five exact-source skeptics must reject value-dependent branching or coercion beyond storage/restoration; the representative set is evidence, not a claim to enumerate JavaScript values.
grammar_contract.consumption: Always succeed, consume zero UTF-16 code units, and leave the following grammar at the candidate offset.
grammar_contract.diagnostics: In explicit package disabled/enabled modes, preserve furthest, expected own-property/reference/ordered values, suggestions array and entry identities/fields, secondarySpans array and entry identities/fields, and the global diagnostics mode.
diagnostic_profiles: undefined expected with multiple diagnostics before
grammar_contract.diagnostic_sandbox: A candidate-local Parser wrapper may snapshot/restore only parser and diagnostic bookkeeping around direct core-combinator recognition. Its work is candidate cost. It may not import diagnostics, change global mode, inspect/derive state.src, classify source manually, advance an imperative cursor, or feed a token/CST layer.
grammar_contract.preprocessing: ASCII +, -, ., and digits survive filtering. Assert raw/preprocessed truth only at mapped corresponding retained positions/EOF; never supply an eliminated CRLF interior.
grammar_contract.work_bound: Worst-case O(1) time/space; at most three positions; no whole-number/exponent run, source materialization, token/CST, imperative loop/scanner, or broad remainder capture.
